title: Working with an image or document
goal: Distinguish reading from independently checking a document value.
case: A synthetic invoice image has fields supplied by a prepared transcription.
terms: A system may process text, images or other signals. Here the transcription stands in for an image reader.
Read fields present in the document and retain a pointer to the source.
Recalculate totals and compare against the listed values.
Mark unreadable or absent fields for review rather than inventing a value.
steps: Extract amount, quantity, tax and stated total
Flag mismatches and retain the source ID
example: Invoice shows 2 items at €20 plus €5 tax.
Listed total of €54 triggers review, even if transcription is syntactically valid.
misconception: The notebook performs OCR on a real image.
correction: This core lab uses prepared transcription to teach verification. Image/OCR integration is an optional extension.
change: Correct the listed total and rerun the checker.
metric: Number of correctly checked fields / fields reviewed
lab: Check two synthetic invoices, including a mismatched total.
reading: Google, Develop a generative AI application
